## المخططات — Diagrams & visual documentation

#### ACRAFT-01 · مخطط أولي ومنظمات بصرية ملائمة · Low-fi wireframe and ADHD-friendly visual organizers · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إنتاج مخططات ASCII ومنظمات Mermaid مبسطة. — Produce ASCII or sketch wireframes and simple Mermaid organizers for focus.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants screen wireframe, whiteboard sketch or task breakdown visual.
- **كيف / how:** 1. Default to ASCII wireframe; hand-drawn HTML on request. 2. Keep few nodes, color-code, chunk steps. 3. Mermaid for timelines, flows, checklists. 4. Iterate sketch until recognized. **أرقام / params:** style
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`npm:mermaid`](../requirements.md#req-npm-mermaid)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1567-tonone/4396-draft-wireframe` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1806-neurodivergent-visual-org/4844-neurodivergent-visual-org` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1995-hypotyposis/7163-sketch`

## الواجهات والتصميم — Front-end, UI & design systems

#### ACRAFT-02 · نظام ألوان يدعم الوصولية والوضع الداكن · Color system with accessibility and dark mode · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصميم تدرجات ألوان للعلامة والحياد والحالات تحقق التباين في الوضعين الفاتح والداكن. — Design brand, neutral and status colour ramps that meet contrast needs in light and dark modes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Choosing a palette, status semantics, dark-mode, colour-blind support.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick brand primary and a neutral ramp. 2) Define success/warning/error semantics with icon or text backup. 3) Check pairs against 4.5:1 text and 3:1 UI. 4) Re-derive dark mode rather than inverting. 5) Test with colour-blind simulation.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3813-color` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3814-color-accessibility-and-mode`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): universal-design-principles/color (#3813); universal-design-principles/color-accessibility-and-mode (#3814) · theme frontend-ui-design · 3 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3813-color, skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3814-color-accessibility-and-mode

#### ACRAFT-03 · اختبار تحمل الواجهة للمحتوى المتطرف · Content-stress and edge-case UI hardening · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اختبار الواجهة بأسماء طويلة وأرقام كبيرة وصور مفقودة ونصوص مترجمة. — Stress UI against long names, big numbers, missing images and localized strings.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Before shipping components, i18n or RTL checks.
- **كيف / how:** 1) List variable content slots. 2) Test extremes: long, empty, huge, multi-line. 3) Define truncation/wrap rules. 4) Provide image fallbacks. 5) Verify RTL and expanded translations.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3847-factor-of-safety-content-stress`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): universal-design-principles/factor-of-safety-content-stress (#3847) · theme frontend-ui-design · 4 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3847-factor-of-safety-content-stress

#### ACRAFT-04 · تخطيط جشتالت: الشبكة والمحاذاة والتجميع · Gestalt layout: grid, alignment, grouping · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تطبيق المحاذاة والشبكات والتقارب والتشابه لتنظيم التخطيط. — Apply alignment, grid systems, proximity and similarity so layouts read as organized groups.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Layout review, form field grouping, picking columns/gutters/breakpoints.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Align every element to shared edges. 2) Choose columns, gutters, breakpoints and a baseline grid. 3) Group by proximity: gap between groups larger than within. 4) Use similarity for same-function items. 5) Keep labels close to their fields.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3807-alignment` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3808-alignment-grid-systems`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): universal-design-principles/alignment (#3807); universal-design-principles/alignment-grid-systems (#3808) · theme frontend-ui-design · 6 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3807-alignment, skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3808-alignment-grid-systems

#### ACRAFT-05 · تدقيق التسلسل البصري والمسافات · Refactoring-UI hierarchy and spacing audit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تدقيق واجهة من حيث التسلسل والمسافات واللون والعمق وتقييمها بقائمة فحص. — Audit a UI for hierarchy, spacing, color and depth and score it with a yes/no checklist.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** UI looks amateur, spacing/colour inconsistency, component styling review.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Judge hierarchy in grayscale/blurred first. 2) Limit emphasis levers (size, weight, colour) to one or two per element. 3) Use spacing scale 4/8/16/24/32/48/64 with group gaps larger than inner gaps. 4) Cap text width at 45-75 chars. 5) Score = round(passed/8*10) from 8 checks. 6) Add colour and shadows last. **أرقام / params:** screenshot or code
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3438-ux-design/14122-refactoring-ui` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3840-snr-emphasis-economy`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): ux-design/refactoring-ui (#14122); universal-design-principles/snr-emphasis-economy (#3840) · theme frontend-ui-design · 7 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/3438-ux-design/14122-refactoring-ui, skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3840-snr-emphasis-economy

#### ACRAFT-06 · تدقيق الضجيج البصري وإزالة الزخرفة · Signal-to-noise decoration audit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إزالة الزخرفة الزائدة وتوزيع التأكيد بحيث يكسب كل عنصر مكانه. — Remove or densify decoration and budget emphasis so each cue earns its place.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Cluttered or sterile screens, deciding what to delete.
- **كيف / how:** 1) List each decorative element. 2) Ask what information it carries; delete if none. 3) If too sparse, densify. 4) Allocate emphasis (colour, weight, size, motion) sparingly. 5) Re-check hierarchy.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3838-snr-decoration-removal` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3744-wabi-sabi-restraint`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): universal-design-principles/snr-decoration-removal (#3838); universal-design-principles/wabi-sabi-restraint (#3744) · theme frontend-ui-design · 6 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3838-snr-decoration-removal, skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3744-wabi-sabi-restraint

#### ACRAFT-07 · قواعد الخط والمقروئية للويب · Typography and legibility rules for web · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اختيار الخطوط والأحجام والمقاييس وطول السطر لمقروئية أفضل. — Choose typefaces, sizes, scales and line lengths for legible web typography.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Setting type scale, readability complaints, font pairing.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick a modular type scale. 2) Body size at least 16px, line-height about 1.5. 3) Line length 45-75 characters. 4) Limit to 1-2 families and few weights. 5) Establish typographic hierarchy via size/weight contrast.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3438-ux-design/14126-web-typography` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3826-legibility-typeface-and-size`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): ux-design/web-typography (#14126); universal-design-principles/legibility-typeface-and-size (#3826) · theme frontend-ui-design · 4 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/3438-ux-design/14126-web-typography, skills/1503-universal-design-principles/3826-legibility-typeface-and-size
